Improving Ways of Working

How can I improve a business process?

Short Answer

Understand the current process and user needs, identify delays or repeated work, and test a small improvement with the people who use it.

Detailed Guidance

Map the current steps with the people who perform or rely on the process, including hand-offs, delays and exceptions. Agree the problem to solve, test a small change with users, measure whether it helps, and consider accessibility, risk and records impacts before adopting it.
